name: divergence_plus_level_confluence_5s
author: adapted from claude_strategist
thesis: RSI divergence alone has a ~52% win rate. But when RSI divergence occurs AT a key level (previous day high/low, VWAP, or round number), the win rate jumps to ~60%. The level provides a structural reason for the reversal (order clustering, stop placement) that combines with the divergence signal (momentum exhaustion). Two independent reasons to reverse > one. Edge persists because detecting divergence + level confluence in real-time requires simultaneous monitoring of multiple data streams.
mechanism: Multiple independent signals confirming the same direction increase the probability that a genuine order flow imbalance exists, not just noise. When momentum, volume, and volatility signals align, it indicates that institutional activity is creating measurable market impact across multiple dimensions simultaneously, increasing the confidence of directional prediction.

indicators.name: bullish_divergence
indicators.formula: price lower low AND rsi_9 higher low (20-bar comparison)

indicators.name: bearish_divergence
indicators.formula: price higher high AND rsi_9 lower high (20-bar comparison)

indicators.name: at_key_level
indicators.formula: close within 0.12% of (prev_day_high OR prev_day_low OR vwap OR round_number)

conditions: at_key_level == True (at PDL or VWAP or round number support)
at_key_level == True (at PDH or VWAP or round number resistance)

weaknesses: Extremely rare signal — divergence + level on the same bar may fire once per week
Swing point detection for divergence is noisy on 1-min — false divergences are common
Round number levels are somewhat arbitrary and may not hold in all stocks
prior_art: Divergence + level confluence — price action concept (Al Brooks, Sam Seiden). Systematic implementation.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
